desc: An MR noise scan often acquired alongside another MR scan. These noise scans are acquired by disabling the radio frequency excitation, while maintaining all other parameters from the associated scan. These can be acquired using some other sequence with RF excitation removed or as part of sequences that turns off RF at the beginning or end of a run. For example a `bold` scan where a few volumes are acquired with RF off. There is no consistent DICOM denotation for these scans. If multiple sequences with different suffixes but otherwise the same entities have `noRF` sequences, they SHOULD be disambiguated using the modality entity (for example, `mod-bold_noRF.nii.gz` and `mod-cbv_noRF.nii`). `noRF` are typically used to estimate properties of the scanner and sequence that are independent from the object being imaged. Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.
